sourceRefs.locator: No. 22, beginning on p. 49: original AN K 4 no. 7; Corbery, competing claims of Saint-Denis and Sept-Meules, and dating by Childeric’s ninth year.

Heading, opening and dating clause: 1 March 752, Verberie, rex Francorum. Narrative: Loba’s testament, Gislemar’s admission and surrender per festucam, Fulrad, and the preceding hearing before King Chilperic.
Opening, “Replacing the ruling dynasty”: Pippin’s two documentary titles, the limits on dating the change, contemporary Roman evidence and the retrospective accounts produced under Carolingian rule.

summary.de: Hausmeier im Original von 751, in der Urkunde aus Verberie König der Franken.
summary.en: Mayor of the palace in the surviving original of 751, king of the Franks in the Verberie judgment.
